run_visualize_masc_disc: run the script to visualize attention masks from TouristDiscrete and GuideDiscrete model checkpoints
load_TouristDiscrete_model: load a trained TouristDiscrete model checkpoint from a file path using the load method
load_GuideDiscrete_model: load a trained GuideDiscrete model checkpoint from a file path using the load method
encode_actions_with_ActionAgnosticDictio: encode directional actions like UP RIGHT DOWN LEFT into integer codes using ActionAgnosticDictionary
extract_guide_attention_masks: extract and visualize 3x3 attention masks from the guide model action embeddings using softmax
